# cubepath_lb_health_check (Resource)

Manages the health check of a load balancer listener (one per listener). Targets that fail it stop receiving traffic. Import with loadbalancer_id/listener_id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `listener_id` (String) UUID of the listener.
- `loadbalancer_id` (String) UUID of the load balancer.

### Optional

- `expected_codes` (String) HTTP status codes that count as healthy: a code, a range or a comma list (200,301-302). Defaults to 200-399.
- `healthy_threshold` (Number) Consecutive successes to mark a target healthy, 1 to 10. Defaults to 2.
- `http_method` (String) HTTP method: GET or HEAD. Defaults to GET.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between checks, 5 to 300. Defaults to 30.
- `path` (String) Path requested by http and https checks. Defaults to /.
- `port` (Number) Port to check. Omit it to check the target port.
- `protocol` (String) Check protocol: http, https or tcp. Defaults to http.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Check timeout, 1 to 60 and lower than interval_seconds. Defaults to 5.
- `unhealthy_threshold` (Number) Consecutive failures to mark a target unhealthy, 1 to 10. Defaults to 3.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) loadbalancer_id/listener_id.
